// About

One Person.
One Studio.

DigitalPrism Studios is a one-person AI multimedia studio built, operated, and created entirely by Charles Westberry IV.

The studio produces original characters, original music, and original visual content across Instagram and YouTube — all powered by AI as a legitimate creative tool in the hands of a single creator.

Every character has a canon. Every track has a purpose. Every image tells a story. This isn't generated content — this is a fully realized creative universe built one asset at a time.

Home of the Crimson Anarchy universe, the Terminal Reset screenplay, and the Transmission album series.
